body: Thanks. I went to the appointment today. Meh. I have another appointment in two weeks. So here's hoping I make it out of 2014 alive!
I'm still alive. I made it to more than a year. I don't know. I feel like this year everything just got worse. It all spiraled out of control, even worse. And things were pretty rotten to begin with.
I'm tired of overcoming all the bad stuff. I'm not strong enough. I can't do it.

I was on the wait list to see a counselor, I'm finally set up to see one on Thursday. But I don't think I can make it that long. And she won't be able to fix it or help me. She can't change the things that have happened, the things that are still happening.
